description: This PHP class 'EmailQueueService' manages email queuing, sending, and status updates within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with email data objects, handles email sending via an email service, and manages email statuses in the database.

classes.name: EmailQueueService
classes.description: Service class for managing email queue operations, including adding emails to the queue, sending individual or all pending emails, and updating email statuses.

methods.name: getEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the EmailQueueDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns the EmailService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Creates a new Mail object with provided details and saves it to the email queue.

methods.name: sendSingleMail
methods.description: Sends a single email by its ID, updating its status accordingly.

methods.name: resetEmailService
methods.description: Resets the email message fields in the EmailService.

methods.name: changeMailStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Mail object and sets the sent timestamp if applicable.

methods.name: sendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Retrieves all pending email IDs and sends each one.
